title: ai/context.json
description: What the owner is looking at in Marklore, for the AI's get_context: written by the app whenever it changes (only when the value differs from the last one written), read by the MCP server when asked. Either a note open to AI with its selection, or no note.

file.description: Absolute path of the note open in Marklore, inside a library open to AI.

selection.description: The text selected in it, or null when nothing (or only white space) is selected.

text.description: The selected text, cut to 20000 UTF-16 code units.

from.description: Where the selection starts in the note's text as the editor holds it, in UTF-16 code units; null when unknown. A reader checks the text is there and otherwise searches for it.

closed.description: True when a note is open but not in a library open to AI.
